description: Thresholds for cynic audit churn. When a metric crosses its threshold, the audit proposes a rule evolution.

commits_per_week.description: Total commits in the last 7 days

feature_ratio_pct.description: Percentage of commits that are features (feat:) in the last 30 days

files_touched_per_30d.description: Number of .rs files touched in the last 30 days

god_object_lines.description: Max lines in any single crate's .rs files

author_identities.description: Number of distinct author identities in the last 30 days

restore_commits_per_week.description: Commits matching restore/fix(main)/compile in the last 7 days

docs_ratio_pct.description: Percentage of commits that are docs in the last 30 days
